statements.status_notes: GitHub Security Advisory and Scout report the fix in @sveltejs/kit 3.0.0. Temporal UI 2.57.x pins Kit 2.70.2 for compatibility with its Svelte 5 and Vite 6 toolchain; overriding to Kit 3.0.0 fails svelte-kit sync because Kit 3 expects Vite APIs (parseSync) not provided by the pinned Vite 6 line. A major Kit upgrade needs upstream Temporal UI alignment and full build and browser test validation before it can ship.
